name: Equilibrium Initiate (Piety)
body:
Note Piety feats are intended for divine-classed followers of a specific deity. Each piety feat indicates which deity in question you must have selected as your patron deity. You cannot retrain or swap out a piety feat by any means, except as described below. Should you no longer meet any of the prerequisites of a piety feat, you lose all benefits of that piety feat (including spells added to your spell list or feat(s) gained from the piety feat). If you have lost access to a piety feat in this manner, you can either seek atonement (as determined by a powerful outsider sent by your deity) to regain the benefits and use of your piety feat or you may retrain it out for another feat that you meet the prerequisites for.

However, if you wish to retrain out a defunct and inaccessible piety feat for another piety feat granted by a new patron deity, you must wait at least 30 days and prove your worth (as determined by the GM) to the church of your new patron deity before you can select the piety feat associated with that deity.

You can possess multiple piety feats if they have the same specific patron deity listed in their prerequisites; otherwise, you cannot have more than one piety feat.

Prerequisite(s): 3 class levels in any one divine spellcasting class, spellcasting mental ability score 13+ for that divine spellcasting class and an equal or greater corresponding physical ability score (see the Balanced Education trait for details), and Deific Obedience [this god]; you must have [this god] as your patron deity and your alignment must not be LG (or must be within the alignment restriction of your divine spellcasting class that requires a patron deity).

Benefits: As a free action on your turn, you can use a special divine power granted by this god under certain lighting conditions, becoming difficult to perceive and affect. As long as you are in an area of dim light (including starlight), you are treated as if you are under the effects of a silk self spell. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to your character level (minimum 1). These rounds need not be consecutive.

You also add the spells below at the spell level listed to the spell list of any and all divine spellcasting classes you possess that meet the prerequisites of this piety feat.

Adding these spells as spells known does not count against your spells known limit for any such divine spellcasting classes in this manner. If you possess the balance domain, these spells are also considered domain spells for the balance domain.

0th– root; 1st-martial master; 2nd–certain grip, recentering drone, surefoot boots; 3rd-dream shield; 4th-negative rain; 5th-[this god]’s blessing, covetous aura
